title: Show that a value may be absent
summary: Haskell: Show that a value may be absent. Try showScore Nothing.
introduction: Maybe holds Nothing or Just a value. Pattern matching handles both safely.
learningObjectives: Show that a value may be absent with Haskell

blocks.text: Install GHC. Save one example as lesson.hs and run runghc lesson.hs. Keep any definitions above main in the same file.
Show that a value may be absent

blocks.title: Show that a value may be absent
blocks.code:
showScore Nothing = "No score"
showScore (Just n) = show n
main = putStrLn (showScore (Just 8))

blocks.text: Just 8 matches the second definition. show makes its number into text.
